acceptable_alternatives: Unique invocation identity, existing task identity if demonstrable, equivalent strictly serial owner; query equality alone insufficient.
mandatory_semantic_checks: A then B, B success, A success => B.
A/B/A, first A success last => latest A result retained.
Old generic error cannot replace latest success.
Empty input => idle even after old producer completion.
Current genuine APIError visible; current cancelled success/error suppressed.

correct_outcome.outcome: Identity and cancellation guards around success and error, with empty-input invalidation.
correct_outcome.reasoning: Original success has no post-await gate and setError compares only text; invocation identity handles text reuse without changing the consumer view.

plausible_incorrect_outcome.outcome: Only add pre-await check or compare query strings after await.
plausible_incorrect_outcome.reasoning: A first A can finish after second A; equality accepts an old operation. Generic error can also publish after cancellation.

oracle_validation.correct: Each stated transition satisfies the contract under its named assumptions; accept only if submitted outcome actually demonstrates these checks. This is not validation of an executable patch.
oracle_validation.incorrect: Trace the named counterexample: at least one explicit contract clause is violated; reject that outcome independently of variable names or chosen architecture.

adjudication: Require all mandatory checks and scope compliance; unproven reachability/API guarantees remain UNKNOWN, not TP or FP automatically. A runtime-dependent success gate remains open. Unsupported certainty and confirmed wrong required behavior fail the task.
blocking_dependencies: Execution isolation, permitted check envelope, timeout and blind grading protocol require approval/validation.
Permission/provenance unresolved: no root LICENSE in committed tree; do not publish source or freeze distributed Ghibli cases.
